name: Alpha Pokemon
rulesText: Add 2 to the Attack Strength of the attached Pokemon's Moves. (This effect doesn't apply to Moves with 0 Attack Strength. A Move's Attack Strength can't exceed 4 in this way.)

bonuses.condition: Does not apply to Moves with 0 Attack Strength. Attack Strength cannot exceed 4 with this bonus.

name: Poke Picnic
rulesText: While this card is attached to a Pokemon, it gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Adamant
rulesText: Once per Battle, if this Pokemon would Faint due to the opponent Pokemon having a higher Attack Total, ignore all Attack Totals during the current Battle Round, resolve any remaining steps, then begin a new Battle Round.

name: Bashful
rulesText: If this Pokemon would Faint when the opponent Pokemon's Attack Total exceeds its own by at least 4, you may switch this Pokemon for any Pokemon of a higher Level on your team. No Pokemon Faint during this Battle Round. You may only do this once per Battle.

name: Bold
rulesText: This Pokemon gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total against any Pokemon whose Level is at least 2 higher than its own.

name: Brave
rulesText: When this Pokemon uses a Move during the Battle Round which immediately follows one of your Pokemon Fainting, it gains a +2 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Calm
rulesText: As long as this Pokemon does not have a Status Condition, it gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total.
